query.description: Returns data after this date. Accepts ISO8601 and Epoch/Unix timestamps
Returns data before this date. Accepts ISO8601 and Epoch/Unix timestamps

**[Optional]** Time format of the timestamps in the return payload.
**[Defaults]** `milliseconds | ms* | iso | iso8601 | hr | human_readable`

**[Optional]** The asset for which to retrieve the most current data.
**[Default]** All available assets.
**[Optional]** Aggregate on quote volume instead of base volume.

**[Optional]** The order in which to return the results, ordered by volumeUSD (ascending or descending). By default, records are returned in descending order, so the records with the largest volume are returned first.

**[Optional]** Payload only includes data after this date (inclusive).
**[Formats]** `seconds | milliseconds | iso8601`
**[Examples]** `1578531600 | 1578531600000 | 2020-09-01T01:00:00`

**[Optional]** Payload only includes data before this date (exclusive).
**[Formats]** `seconds | milliseconds | iso8601`
**[Examples]** `1578531600 | 1578531600000 | 2020-09-01T01:00:00`

**[Optional]** Time format of the timestamps in the return payload.
**[Defaults]** `milliseconds | ms* | iso | iso8601 | hr | human_readable`
